english.title: Excluded civil explosive manufacturer fail to indicate name / trade name / trade mark / address
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a manufacturer of a civil explosive which was excluded from the scope of regulations 33, 34 and 36 of the Explosives Regulations 2014 by virtue of regulation 3(15), namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVE..), failed, before placing such a civil explosive on the market to indicate on it your name or registered trade name or registered trade mark or a postal address at which you could be contacted
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 44(1)(b) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and (2) of, and paragraph 7(m) of Schedule 12 to, the Health and Safety at Work Act etc. 1974.
